author: gabrielribcesario
body:
#### PR description:

Adding @tomalin to the loop.

Extensive, detailed description of the problems (and reproducers) can be found here: https://github.com/gabrielribcesario/cmssw/tree/l1trigger-bugs-reproducers/L1TriggerBugsReproducers.

- `InputRouter.cc`: Change assertion condition from `iadd != 1` to `iadd > 1` to allow stubs with zero phi region matches (rare but valid due to stub phi corrections).
- `SensorModule.cc`: Fix `TTStub` column/bend sign calculations to account for 180 barrel yaw flips.

#### PR validation:

Re-ran the reproducers described in https://github.com/gabrielribcesario/cmssw/tree/l1trigger-bugs-reproducers/L1TriggerBugsReproducers, no crashes were observed.
title: L1Trigger: Fix stub association assert and sensor sign calculations
